judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the fix, leaving the `error instanceof Error` gate untouched. As a result, all the new tests added in `src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts` for non-Error rejections will fail, breaking `npm test`. Furthermore, those tests do not assert that `onError` is called strictly once, and `.lore/dod.md` was left tracked in the diff. On the positive side, the candidate did update `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and wrote tests covering the requested rejection types (string, plain object, undefined, Error).
